title: Morning, the fog lifting
logline: The morning after the first: the fog lifting off the flats in a line, the mud appearing under it, the pup walking into the clear part. Light inside the fog, then light on the mud.

panels.composition: Mudflats with fog lifting in a straight line across them, gray above and gold mud appearing below, an old three-legged dog walking from the fog into the clear.

image.prompt: a single full comic page with no panel borders, spare knowing ink line with economy, muted ochre and slate blue and sea-foam green washes, tidal mudflats with fog lifting in a straight line across them showing gold mud beneath, an old three-legged dog walking out of the fog into the clear, luminous, no words

art.line: spare, knowing; economy of line; Era I's black spotting back on purpose in the mill run
art.palette: muted ochres, slate blues, misty sea-foam greens; luminous sunbreaks in the last spring
